title: [Main]-[Escalated] [Strategic] [BC-IN]Online: Performance issue in General journal line from June 17th 2026 - 2606170030006074
summary: Removed redundant SaveRecord calls from TCS journal page extensions that were causing performance degradation during line entry by triggering unnecessary database writes and workflow evaluations.
key_points: Eliminated redundant CurrPage.SaveRecord() from UpdateTaxAmount() method in TCS journal pages
Aligns TCS pages with GST, TDS, and Tax Base pages that were already fixed
Reduces unnecessary database writes and workflow evaluations during journal line entry
Addresses performance lag in environments with many enabled workflows
